value: Two arthroscopic surgeons at associate-chief level or above independently viewed each complete recording and rated six GRS dimensions from 1 to 5, blinded to each other's ratings.
Rater 1 had 15 years and rater 2 had 11 years of arthroscopy experience. The source note states that neither participated in model development or results analysis.
Average the independent totals, retaining 0.5-point granularity. Differences of at least 6 total-score points trigger joint review and a decision to retain or revise the ratings.
Two-way random-effects, single-rater absolute-agreement ICC(A,1) = 0.823; the source note refers to the manuscript for the confidence interval and labels 0.75-0.90 as good agreement.
